scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev -w @flowforge/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @flowforge/api" "npm run dev -w @flowforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowforge/api && npm run build -w @flowforge/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flowforge/api && npm run test -w @flowforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @flowforge/api && npm run typecheck -w @flowforge/web
